================================================================================
PART 2: COACHING LINEAGE TREES & COACH PROFILES
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: SHANAHAN / KUBIAK WIDE-ZONE TREE [ID: shanahan-kubiak]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: Bill Walsh → Mike Shanahan & Gary Kubiak
Category: OFFENSE
System Summary: The most influential offensive lineage in modern NFL football. Stemming from Bill Walsh’s West Coast spacing and Mike Shanahan & Gary Kubiak’s legendary Denver Broncos zone-stretch run game. Powers today’s elite offenses led by Kyle Shanahan, Sean McVay, Klint Kubiak, Matt LaFleur, and Mike McDaniel through horizontal stretch runs, play-action deep shots, and disguise meshes identical for the first 1.2 seconds.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: ANDY REID WEST COAST / SPREAD RPO TREE [ID: reid-west-coast]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: Bill Walsh → Andy Reid
Category: OFFENSE
System Summary: A pillar of modern offensive innovation. Blends classic West Coast rhythm and pass spacing with modern college Spread RPOs, empty/bunch formations, Mesh shallow crosses, jet shovel screens, and 13-personnel tight-end power mismatches.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: PETE CARROLL / ROBERT SALEH WIDE-9 & MATCH TREE [ID: carroll-saleh-wide9]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: Pete Carroll → Robert Saleh
Category: DEFENSE
System Summary: A defensive system defined by pure physical dominance and gap-integrity. Employs wide-9 defensive end splits and penetrating 3-techniques to create organic 4-man pressure, backed by disciplined Cover 3 Rip/Liz Match, split-field Cover 6 bracket coverages, and A-gap cross-dog fire zones.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: MIKE MACDONALD SIM-PRESSURE & HYBRID DISGUISE TREE [ID: macdonald-pressure]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: John Harbaugh → Mike Macdonald
Category: DEFENSE
System Summary: The cutting edge of NFL defensive design. Built on pre-snap ambiguity, Double-A mug and Amoeba fronts, 4-man Simulated Pressures (Creepers) dropping interior linemen into throwing windows while sending DBs, post-snap split safety spins, and Cover 0 peel blitzes.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: VIC FANGIO TWO-HIGH SHELL & QUARTERS TREE [ID: fangio-two-high]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: Vic Fangio
Category: DEFENSE
System Summary: The defensive system that forced modern offenses to adapt. Shows a static two-high safety shell before the snap to disguise Cover 6, Cover 8, and Quarters match calls, paired with light 3-man Penny fronts to stifle explosive downfield crossers and force long, mistake-prone drives.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACHING TREE: BILL BELICHICK / BRIAN FLORES PSYCHO BLITZ TREE [ID: belichick-flores]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Patriarch: Bill Belichick → Brian Flores
Category: DEFENSE
System Summary: A radical, highly aggressive defensive philosophy based on extreme binary pressure looks: either sending 6-7 rushers in all-out Cover 0 house blitzes, or bluffing everybody and dropping 8 into muddy coverage zones.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COACH PROFILES (20 ARCHITECTS)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

>>> COACH: Bill Walsh [ID: bill-walsh]
    Role (2026): Pro Football Hall of Fame Patriarch
    Team / Institution: San Francisco 49ers (Patriarch)
    Category: OFFENSE
    Tree Branch: shanahan-kubiak
    Mentor: paul-brown
    Disciples: mike-shanahan, andy-reid, mike-holmgren, george-seifert
    Key Schemes: shanahan-wide-zone
    Philosophy: The architect of the West Coast Offense: short, horizontal rhythm passing as a controlled extension of the run game, utilizing spacing, timed drops, and run-after-catch geometry to manipulate defensive leverage.
    Key Concepts: West Coast Pass Rhythm, Horizontal Field Stretch, Sprint Right Option, Scripted Openers
    Notable Achievements: 3x Super Bowl Champion HC | Pro Football Hall of Fame (1993) | Architect of Modern Passing Geometry

>>> COACH: Mike Shanahan [ID: mike-shanahan]
    Role (2026): 2x Super Bowl Champion HC / Wide Zone Pioneer
    Team / Institution: Denver Broncos / SF 49ers (Patriarch)
    Category: OFFENSE
    Tree Branch: shanahan-kubiak
    Mentor: bill-walsh
    Disciples: kyle-shanahan, sean-mcvay, gary-kubiak, matt-lafleur
    Key Schemes: shanahan-wide-zone
    Philosophy: Pioneered the outside zone stretch run married to Alex Gibbs blocking mechanics, paired with lethal bootleg rollouts and intermediate crossers that tore apart single-high coverages.
    Key Concepts: Outside Zone Stretch, Naked Bootleg Flood, Cutback Lanework, Play-Action Deep Over
    Notable Achievements: 2x Super Bowl Champion HC (XXXII, XXXIII) | 3x Super Bowl Ring Total | Father of the Modern Wide Zone Family

>>> COACH: Gary Kubiak [ID: gary-kubiak]
    Role (2026): Super Bowl 50 Champion HC / Split-Zone Master
    Team / Institution: Denver Broncos / Houston Texans (Patriarch)
    Category: OFFENSE
    Tree Branch: shanahan-kubiak
    Mentor: mike-shanahan
    Disciples: klint-kubiak, kevin-stefanski
    Key Schemes: kubiak-split-zone
    Philosophy: Perfected under-center stretch-zone and split-zone slicing action with the fullback/tight end, unleashing devastating throwback bootlegs, deep dagger shots, and Y-Leaks against over-aggressive front sevens.
